projects.title: Multimodal Transit Path Search
bullets: Implemented shortest-path queries for public multimodal transit networks using Python and NetworkX in a supervised undergraduate independent study.
Compared search times on sampled transportation graphs as part of the supervised path-search project.

projects.title: Walking-Route Graph Search
bullets: Tested disconnected graph cases for public walking-route networks using Python and NetworkX in a supervised undergraduate course project.
Compared search times on sampled walking-route graphs as an assigned contribution to the course project.

research.title: Urban Bus Network Path Search
bullets: Constructed graphs from public urban bus route tables using Python and NetworkX as a student assistant in supervised faculty research.
Implemented shortest-path queries and tested disconnected graph cases for path search on public urban bus networks.
